articles.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
articles.snippet: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.

articles.title: Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
articles.snippet: The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million.

articles.title: MapQuest Now Shows Drivers Where Flock Cameras Are Watching
articles.snippet: MapQuest’s app now offers an optional map layer that plots known license plate readers from Flock Safety and other vendors, as backlash against the cameras grows.

articles.title: Banks Hold a Lever Over Stablecoin Adoption, BIS Economists Say
articles.snippet: A Bank for International Settlements working paper found that stablecoin growth slows when U.S. banks raise deposit rates, with Circle’s USDC most sensitive.

articles.title: GTA 6 Trailer Features Meme Coin—And Solana Copycat Soars 2,900%
articles.snippet: Rockstar released the launch trailer for GTA VI, revealing a potential meme coin in the upcoming game and sending degens wild.
